providers.reason: Fenice can reach the authorized Directa/Darwin API path, but the separate realtime/historical datafeed entitlement is not enabled. Exact-MIC realtime evidence is therefore not available from Directa today.

SIX Market Signal 1BBO launched in September 2026 with direct-from-source realtime BBO/trades across SIX Swiss Exchange, BME and Aquis, a one-month no-card trial and API access. SIX states internal derived-data use is allowed for the trial, but 1BBO is consolidated/indicative across SIX venues; Fenice therefore will not treat it as exact home-MIC evidence. Runtime token entitlement, timestamp semantics and any automated/non-display scope needed for PAPER must be proven before admission.

SIX Exfeed provides direct official realtime Swiss Exchange data and explicitly requires a direct contractual relationship or restricted Non-Display Information Usage agreement for non-display use. Exact XSWX runtime evidence, original provider timestamp and current agreement evidence are required before PAPER.

Official EODHD EU WebSockets provide realtime European trades/quotes sourced from Cboe Europe across 18 home markets, with quotes consolidated across BXE/CXE/DXE. Useful as an independent realtime cross-check, but not exact primary-MIC evidence for Xetra/Milan/Euronext listings and paid-token/use-right evidence is still required.

Cboe Europe offers realtime Top/Last Sale/depth feeds and pan-European coverage. Automated Fenice use is Non-Display under the 2026 policy; trial/display access cannot unlock PAPER without exact venue/instrument mapping and explicit Non-Display entitlement evidence.
Cboe publishes MiFID public trade data with a delay. This is lawful and useful for independent sanity checks, but delayed data can never satisfy Fenice realtime PAPER quorum.

Fenice has a tested fail-closed parser for the official md-xetraetfetp Cloud Stream with exact XETR identity and nanosecond provider timestamps. Deutsche Boerse documents 30-day free access, but current product scope is Xetra ETFs/ETPs rather than blanket Xetra equities and automated/non-display usage rights are not inferred from trial access.

Fenice has a fail-closed parser for official Cloud Stream md-tradegate common-stock messages requiring exact XGAT, expected provider symbol, EUR/expected currency, positive non-crossed explicitly TRADEABLE BBO, ACTIVE/CONTINUOUS state and nanosecond Tm. Free data licensing or public/display access is not treated as runtime entitlement.

Fenice has a tested fail-closed Euronext Stream BBO/StandingData parser binding topic path, symbolIndex, ISIN, exact MIC, currency and nanosecond provider timestamps. Euronext explicitly classifies automated calculations/algorithms as Non-Display Use; the feed remains validation-only until applicable entitlement is proven and hash-bound.

dxFeed offers realtime EU equities and exchange-sourced feeds including Cboe Europe, gettex and Tradegate. PAPER requires commercial entitlement, explicit automated-use rights and exact source/venue mapping.
IBKR Web API supports streaming Level 1 data and exchange-specific requests. Most securities require market-data subscriptions and no authorized IBKR account is connected to Fenice.
Saxo OpenAPI supports realtime streaming quotes, but market-data access requires an authorized account/token and applicable data terms.
Deutsche Boerse distributes exact Xetra equity realtime data through direct feeds and authorized vendors. Applicable market-data and automated/non-display rights must be documented before PAPER.

Twelve Data documents licensed Cboe Europe realtime coverage at MIC BCXE via a data add-on. This can become exact Cboe-venue evidence if account entitlement and automated-use rights are proven, but it must not be mislabeled as exact XETR/XMIL/XPAR home-venue evidence.
JPX/TSE officially provides realtime FLEX market data directly or through market information providers. Exact XTKS runtime evidence and applicable internal/automated-use entitlement remain required.
JPX explicitly offers a 15-minute-delayed stock-price API path. It can be useful for lawful validation and history checks but cannot satisfy realtime PAPER quorum.

HKEX provides realtime data services under Market Data End-User, Vendor and Application Service Provider licensing and publishes specific guidance for Non-Display Usage. Fenice will not treat a vendor/display subscription as automated XHKG entitlement without applicable licence evidence.

ASX MarketSource provides realtime ASX-operated market data including Level 1/2, trades, instrument status and reference data such as ISIN, via direct connectivity or authorized vendors. PAPER requires exact XASX identity, provider timestamps and applicable automated internal-use rights.

TMX Datalinx offers official TSX realtime Level 1/2 and consolidated feeds, with pricing and internal-distribution agreements published separately. Fenice requires a valid subscription/agreement, exact XTSE venue identity and provider/source timestamps before PAPER admission.
International realtime stock quotes require separately verified enterprise market-data entitlement; no such entitlement is persisted in Fenice.
Free service is end-of-day and current public intraday positioning does not establish exact-venue international realtime entitlement for Fenice.
Public cross-check only; never satisfies PAPER quorum.
